integrity: The analytic proof is provided in full; finite reproducibility checks are separated from general logical claims. The 2023 source publication time and primary MSC were verified against the first arXiv version; no independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Real finite weighted cycles on at least four vertices and strictly positive weights; determines precisely when the index equals one, not exact values below one. Originality remains subject to unindexed-equivalence bibliographic risk. Supplementary finite rational checks are not proof for arbitrary weights.
title: Numerical-index-one rigidity for weighted cycles and positive cube sections
